description: 4x 96^3 CNN (DatNet smoothing-off + Siamese + SliceNet 2.5D + MedicalNet r10 z-scored) 80% + SBR/LightGBM 20%, equal-weight logit blend

sm0.train_aug: original axes, geometric strength 1.5x (rot 15.0, trans 0.090, scale 0.075, intensity 0.1), label smoothing 0.0

siamese.tta_note: structurally L<->R invariant, so R-L mirror TTA is a mathematical no-op (verified exact); S-I flips plus rotation and scale are worth +0.0341 standalone
siamese.train_aug: corrected axes (R-L mirror, axial rotation), strength 1.0x, label smoothing 0.05

med3d._stem_stride_note: ignored: conv1 is 7^3 stride 2 + maxpool, there is no configurable stem
med3d.norm_note: PER-SCAN z-scoring, not the global /CUBE_SCALE the other families use. MedicalNet was pretrained on zero-mean/unit-variance volumes; Notes.md §32 measured +0.0227 for the pretrained model and -0.0298 for a random-init one, so this is domain matching and is NOT optional.
med3d.train_aug: original axes, geometric strength 1.5x, label smoothing 0.0, per-scan z-score

oof.note: these are the checkpoints IN this package. The development run m3d_pre_std scored 0.2812/0.9499; that number must not be quoted for this artifact.

external_weights.source: MedicalNet / Med3D r10 (Chen, Ma & Zheng 2019, arXiv:1904.00625)
external_weights.licence: MIT (Tencent / THL A29) — permits commercial use
external_weights.pretraining_data: aggregate of 23 public 3D medical CT/MRI segmentation datasets
external_weights.shipped: fine-tuned state_dict only; the original resnet_10_23dataset.pth is NOT required in the ZIP because the fine-tuned weights are self-contained
external_weights.DISCLOSURE: rule 5 requires external data AND pretrained models to be disclosed to the organizers. ANSWERED by the organizers 2026-07-31 (jury/ORGANIZER_CORRESPONDENCE.md): permissively licensed (MIT/Apache) weights are fine, upstream training-data licences do not matter unless the model itself is non-permissive, and there is NO need to disclose until after the competition closes -- they contact winners then. No pre-submission forum post is required.

med3d._reproducibility: NOT bit-reproducible. Diagnosed precisely: PyTorch has no deterministic `max_pool3d_with_indices_backward_cuda`. Removing the max-pool makes two independent runs byte-identical, which isolates it. Measured across FIVE independent retrains: component SD 0.0010, BLEND SD 0.00014 (95% upper bound 0.0004). The shipped weights are pinned by MD5 in submissions/008a_checkpoint_md5s.json.

slicenet._stem_stride_note: ignored: SliceNet is 2.5D and has no 3D stem
slicenet.train_aug: original axes, geometric strength 1.5x, label smoothing 0.0
slicenet._provenance: pos variant. Chosen over nopos on DESIGN grounds, not score: the two are statistically identical (0.2917 vs 0.2910, r=0.9985) and an S-I-invariant net cannot use the S-I flip augmentation, our largest single lever. Retrain reproduced the original OOF BIT-IDENTICALLY (max per-scan diff 0).

cnn_combine: equal-weight mean of the FOUR CNN families' logits (sm0, siamese, slicenet, med3d), then 0.8*that + 0.2*logit(SBR)

oof._note: raw out-of-fold log loss (`oof_raw`). The previous value 0.4104 was `oof_cal`, a Platt fit scored on its own out-of-fold predictions: 0.0300 optimistic and never applied at inference (`calibration_applied: false`).

blend.note: logit space, raw booster output. w_sbr swept on THIS four-CNN core: 0.10 -> 0.2477, 0.15 -> 0.2469, 0.20 -> 0.2472, 0.25 -> 0.2485. Broad optimum; 0.20 retained for continuity. (This field previously contained the TWO-CNN 005 curve by copy-paste.)

calibration_note: None. The Platt constants exported for 003 were fitted on the OOF they were scored on and are not reproducible at inference. Cross-fitted temperature scaling measured worse than raw. All CV figures here use raw booster output, matching what this code computes.

cv.basis: SHIPPED configuration: sm0 scored under the si_rl TTA scheme and the med3d checkpoints contained in this package. Development variants of either component give slightly different numbers and are not quoted here.
cv.vs_005: +0.0078 (P=0.975, centre-clustered 95% CI [-0.0000, +0.0149]). Probably better, but the interval TOUCHES zero. Stable under leave-one-centre-out (+0.0049 to +0.0099), unlike 006 which flips sign.
cv.honest_note: ⚠ Inherits TWO arm selections (slicenet from 4 configs, med3d from 18 arms of which 17 made the blend WORSE). Replacing each argmin with its menu mean drops the gain to +0.0002, so the truth is bracketed [+0.0002, +0.0078]. Notes.md §33/§34. 005 remains the default; this is the challenger.
cv.reproducibility: The med3d family is NOT bit-reproducible (PyTorch has no deterministic max_pool3d_with_indices_backward_cuda). Retraining reproduces this blend to within a small tolerance measured over repeated independent retrains; the exact shipped weights are pinned by MD5 in submissions/008a_checkpoint_md5s.json.
cv.correction_2026_07_31: An earlier build of this file stated log_loss 0.2468, auroc 0.9608 and "+0.0082 (P=0.985, 95% CI [+0.0009, +0.0152]) — the ONLY candidate whose interval excludes zero". Those figures came from a development OOF (m3d_pre_std), not from the checkpoints shipped here, and on the shipped basis the interval does NOT exclude zero. Quoting the favourable basis was our error; it is corrected here and in jury/SOLUTION_REPORT.md §6.
